entry_surfaces./: asymmetric kinetic hero with live catalog teaser left, floating warm bookstore imagery + featured book right

entry_surfaces./admin: dense functional command center — statistics bento top, book CRUD & order tables below

motion.entrance_preset: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
motion.editorial_marquee: slow continuous smooth drift (duration 35-45s) for category ribbon using CSS or motion transform

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for body copy, 3:1 for large display)
accessibility.data_testid_policy: MANDATORY on all buttons, category filters, book cards, checkout inputs, payment buttons, and admin actions
accessibility.reduced_motion: respects prefers-reduced-motion using conditional CSS/motion configs

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme setup in frontend/src/index.css: import '@fontsource-variable/lora', '@fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans', and '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'.
Configure --font-heading to 'Lora Variable', serif, and --font-sans to 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', sans-serif.

Implement the simulated payment modal with QRIS / Virtual Account mock state that simulates a 2-second gateway validation, then displays success and automatically opens wa.me link with prefilled order template to 085173290889.

For physical books, provide a Dual CTA: 'Pesan Buku Fisik (JNE Ongkir)' which calculates flat JNE rate based on selected Indonesian island/region, AND direct marketplace buttons: Shopee (https://s.shopee.co.id/8AV4Tsb6bM), Tokopedia, and TikTok Shop.
Build a full Admin Panel at /admin with login (pre-seeded admin credentials), CRUD for ebooks and physical books, order listing with filter by digital/physical, and shipping rate editor.

Ensure every interactive element has explicit 'data-testid' like 'buy-digital-button-{book_id}', 'shipping-region-select', 'confirm-payment-button', 'whatsapp-handoff-button', 'admin-book-title-input'.
Keep all UI copy in natural, elegant Bahasa Indonesia with warm bookstore tone.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.layout_philosophy: Combine warm bookstore cozy ambiance (#FAF7F2 ivory cream, amber #DD6B20, terracotta #C05621) with fresh pastel card accents for the 4 language categories.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_rules: Never center-align whole pages. Use asymmetric 12-column layouts, rich micro-interactions on hover, refined borders (#E8DFC8), and warm serif headers paired with clean sans body.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.motion_polish: Add subtle entry transitions, hover lifts, sticky glass nav with blur, and smooth category filter animations using motion/react.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_handling: Use sonner Toaster for checkout feedback, order tracking confirmation, and admin CRUD notifications.
